mapper.insert: insert into message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, is_read, time) values (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, 0, #{time})
mapper.select: select * from message where (sender_id = #{me} and receiver_id = #{other}) or (sender_id = #{other} and receiver_id = #{me}) order by id desc limit 50
mapper.update: update message set is_read = 1 where sender_id = #{other} and receiver_id = #{me} and is_read = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from message where receiver_id = #{me} and is_read = 0
